# Fresh hierarchy-to-finite reconstruction host

Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

Connect the existing conditional checker and serialized finite checker on the
same immutable external artifact. This packet implements inspection and fresh
reconstruction, not a production `VerifiedProgram`, an independently requested
root contract, reference execution, or external schema enablement.

The external envelope follows the selected version-one hierarchy JSON. Decode
all fields strictly, preserve prefix type trees and raw UTF-8 leaf strings,
and propose a topological schedule from actual table references. Send all four
tables, entry and schedule to the separately built Lean executable through a
bounded private binary transport. Its total decoder reconstructs actual kernel
structures; `Conditional.checkAll` rechecks the complete graph, typing and rules.
No supplied cache, success flag, hash, Lean expression or executable source is
accepted. The transport is outside the pure acceptance core.

The freshly invoked runtime returns only pending finite proof indices and work
statistics. The existing `RequestsBound` theorem ties those indices to the
actual complete bytes and endpoints. The host projects those requests from
the same retained JSON value, decodes exact type/owner/axis boundaries and calls
`check_serialized_unitary` for every request with one shared budget. Keep raw
outer bytes and every reconstructed leaf. A producer cannot supply the runtime
response. The chosen runtime binary, native compiler and transport correspondence
remain explicit trusted dependencies; this is not K1/K2 completion.

All external schemas remain disabled. Pure supported rules and finite leaves
can be inspected; parsed unsupported nodes must still fail the real checker.
Keep the existing 16 MiB external JSON/payload, one-million JSON values,
100,000 combined nodes, two-million structural and ten-million exact-work
ceilings. The internal transport has a separate 64 MiB bound accommodating
fixed-width framing of already bounded external data, without raising an
external capacity. Every internal number is a little-endian u32; arrays and
byte strings carry lengths. The reader caps individual collections and total
reads, rejects unknown tags/trailing bytes, and preserves every finite byte.

Test valid fresh-process reconstruction and rejection of wrong exact meaning,
global phase, type/owner/axis binding, zero-repeat invalid bodies, altered
counts/premises/encodings, cycles, duplicate/unknown fields and out-of-range
references. Include shared non-expanded powers, reversed meaning-table indices,
malformed internal transport and resource ceilings. Save first source and real
diagnostics before validation. Build/audit both Lean packages, replay the kernel
and transport, run native differential and Rust regression checks, then update
the current records without claiming corpus or release completion.
